summary: Codify autonomous credential-reference and evidence-window rules

delivery.outcome: Agent v1 guidance binds complete credential-reference capability evidence, a non-circular secret bootstrap and symmetric bounded history evidence.
nonGoals: Change the agent JSON Schema, grammar or document family
Publish the missing Hub HTTP endpoint
Read, export or persist a credential value
Turn Inventory metadata or an internal resolver into authority
Weaken semantic thresholds or use an unbounded history scan

architecture.decision: Keep agent v1 closed and clarify that secret configuration requires a complete grant-bound capability chain plus an independent bootstrap root, while history-based decisions require symmetric bounded evidence.
architecture.rollback: Revert the two guidance files while preserving ticket evidence and the unchanged v1 schema and grammar.
